ai_summary: Aptech Limited has successfully reclassified Mr. Utpal Sheth from its 'Promoter group' to the 'Public' category, effective September 9, 2026, after receiving no-objection letters from both BSE and NSE. This regulatory compliance move, under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, materially shifts the company's reported ownership structure by increasing its public shareholding. No immediate red flags are apparent, as the reclassification has been duly approved by the stock exchanges.
